annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes Prime DeFi as a way to earn 60%–120% or more in yearly passive crypto income and presents profit as effectively assured. The host reinforces the solicitation with testimonials, claims that people who take action get results, directs viewers to start through a linked free training, and says Dan Ryder will ensure participants are in profit. These claims and calls to participate promote a high-return DeFi earning opportunity rather than neutrally analyzing it.

The offer is promoted through a training and start-now pathway, while the host uses strong safety and profitability assurances to encourage participation.
